rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
cp "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/patches/configs/defconfig" .config sed -e "s@CONFIG_CROSS_COMPILER_PREFIX=\"\"@CONFIG_CROSS_COMPILER_PREFIX=\"$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-\"@g" -i .config
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "tools" ]; then sed -e "s@CONFIG_SYSROOT=\"\"@CONFIG_SYSROOT=\"/tools\"@g" -i .config else sed -e "s@CONFIG_SYSROOT=\"\"@CONFIG_SYSROOT=\"/\"@g" -i .config fi
